meta.sources: Opta event data via WhoScored match centres (19 matches, 2026-27); league context via FBref. xG is a simple distance/angle model, not Opta's.
meta.xgModel: logit = −0.595 − 0.146·distance(m) + 0.571·angle(rad); ×0.7 odds for headers, ×2.5 big chances, ×1.3 counters; penalties 0.76. Calibrated so total model xG ≈ goals scored across the 19 matches.
